title: Rosalind and the Drop
author: Odile Dravenmoor
blurb: Beatrix Amberdale, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, works cases no one wants attributed. Then a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
